policy.selection: IMAGE only when an exact relation has a retained canonical representation whose kind is explicitly pictorial/scene/body/person/action. Ambiguous exact routes go to REVIEW; rejected/deferred lexical relations remain in the catalog.
policy.homophones: All exact words sharing an IPA are preserved; no winner is selected by sound.
policy.priority: Uses canonical rebus-sound-catalog researchPriorityScore. P0/P1/P2/P3 are data-derived quartiles among IMAGE rows; thresholds are materialized below.
policy.assets: REBULO PIXEL pilot evidence comes from the timestamped Drive registry snapshot. Legacy runtime images are recorded as existing assets but do not imply REBULO PIXEL validation. Visual status never grants human naming evidence or runtime activation.
policy.pilot72: The 72 manifest is evidence/asset coverage for a pilot nucleus only; it does not bound catalog size.
